Question: Suppose a convex 3d-object has k pentagonal faces and m hexagonal faces. All faces are regular. What is k?

Options: 
A. 16
B. 5
C. 10
D. 12
E. 15
F. 8
G. 14
H. 25
I. 18
J. 20

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
